projects

A selection of open-source and client projects I have built over the years. You can find more on my GitHub profile.

  • Financy - open-source, local-first zero-based budgeting app built on double-entry accounting
  • YourAIBase - web aggregator platform to discover and explore AI tools
  • Local Caddie - AirBnB-like caddie booking and golf course management platform
  • MovFlix - movie and TV series catalog powered by the TMDB API
  • Explore APOD - client for exploring NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day archive
  • MLDSpot - customer loyalty program web application
  • InstaLiveWeb - third-party Instagram Live RTMP dashboard for OBS Studio
  • Raven Raffles 2.0 - SaaS web application for automated sneaker raffle entries
